newsitem.title: USA: Sport-Haley says holder has five pct.
newsitem.headline: Sport-Haley says holder has five pct.

text.p: Golf apparel designer Sport-Haley Inc said Monday that Delaware Management Holdings Inc had advised the Securities and Exchange Commission that it owned more than five percent of the company's stock.
It said Delaware had filed a Form 13G with the commission announcing it owned about 237,000 shares or 5.36 percent of Sport-Haley.
Delaware is a parent holding company for the Delaware Group of Funds.
"We welcome the addition of the Delaware Group of Funds as a greater than five (percent) shareholder of Sport-Haley," it said.
